respiratory.title: About
respiratory.content:
Monkeypox is a rare viral disease similar to smallpox. Initial symptoms, resembling common illnesses, evolve into a distinctive rash.

Diagnosis is challenging, underscoring the importance of timely and accurate identification for effective management. With limited treatment options available.

team.title: AFYIA's staff
team.text: R&D is at the heart of AFYIA Diagnostics and this team is mainly dedicated to it. AFYIA is a scientific company developing innovative solutions for diagnosing infectious diseases, combining molecular biology and artificial intelligence. This R&D is carried out continuously in our laboratory based in Grabels in the south of France.

about.title: About us
about.description:
While diagnostics is the primary means of combating infectious diseases, the vast majority of people living in low- and middle-income countries still do not have access to it. In these countries, infectious diseases are the first cause of mortality.

To help improve access to diagnostics for infectious diseases by developing high-performance, low-cost tools tailored to the needs and constraints of the most demanding laboratory environments, based on three areas of innovation: molecular biology, artificial intelligence and industrial processes.
about.one_health: This approach is based on the scientific and technical expertise acquired by Innovative Diagnostics, which has developed solutions for the veterinary and human sectors, from a "One Health" perspective in in vitro diagnostics.

software.title: DISoft software
software.subtitle: AI-powered software
software.disoft_description: The DISoft software uses an innovative technology based on High Resolution Melting (HRM) DNA analysis powered by artificial intelligence. This technology was developed as part of a longstanding collaboration between ID, the Research Institute for Development (IRD), and the University of Montpellier (UM).

access.description: Software access is provided with the purchase of a kit, for an unlimited time. To request an account, please fill in the form below, including your purchase reference. You will receive the procedure for accessing DISoft by e-mail.

software.disoft_description_2: Based on a patent co-owned by the IRD and UM (Avarre and Reynes, 2017), for which AFYIA holds an exclusive exploitation license, the DISoft software was developed by AFYIA. This software uses artificial intelligence to autonomously analyze and interpret raw melting results, leveraging learning databases specifically created for each new test.
